title: TabsReorderResult
description: Result of the tabs.reorder JSON-RPC method: one workspace's tabs, in the new strip order, with the positions the backend wrote. Scoped to ONE workspace and taking its whole order: a tab belonging to another workspace is not a member here, so naming one is refused rather than treated as a move — reordering a strip never changes membership.

tabs.description: The workspace's tabs, in position order. Never null; an empty array is a real answer.
